acceptance: A report after 14 days gives pull_request and merge_group runner-minutes, PR p50 feedback time, moved-job queue failures with run IDs, and local medium escapes, each against the baseline.
Either no trigger fired, or the rollback landed the same day with a link to the revert PR and a follow-up item for the cause.
The report's numbers are reproducible from pinned run IDs.
context:
WAITING until 2026-10-02: the 14-day watch started when ci-dedupe-06 landed in #2180 on 2026-09-18. The rollback trigger below still applies during the watch; if it fires, act at once rather than waiting. Move back to open on or after 2026-10-02, write the report, then finish.

Trigger (attribution, not rates): 3 or more merge_group failures of a moved job (medium-test, correctness-gate, plan-capture-gate, tpch-binary-framing) in any rolling 7-day window. Failures in jobs that were not moved (code-test, publication reconciliation, audit-sha) do not count toward the trigger.

Attribution when ci-dedupe-09 has landed: that item replaces the full local medium tier with an impact-selected subset, so local coverage is deliberately narrower and "local medium escapes" will rise by design. Before applying the rollback, determine for each moved-job queue failure whether the failing test was in the selected subset for that PR head. A test that was selected, passed locally, and then failed in the queue is a placement signal and counts toward the trigger. A test that was never selected is a selector gap owned by ci-dedupe-09: fix the selector with that concrete case and do not count it. Reverting ci-dedupe-06 would not address a selection gap.

When the trigger fires: apply the pre-authored rollback from the ci-dedupe-06 PR the same day, then investigate. Revert first; do not tune thresholds or add exceptions to keep the change.

Also track, without triggering rollback: pull_request runner-minutes, PR p50 feedback time, merge_group rebuilds caused by moved-job failures, and local medium escapes. If ci-dedupe-09 landed mid-window, report escapes separately for the full-tier and selected-subset periods and say which baseline each covers; the pre-09 baseline assumes the full local medium tier.

Guardrails: this item does not widen or narrow the moved set; a change in scope needs a new decision item. It also does not own the selector - selection defects route to ci-dedupe-09. Data comes from the Actions jobs API by pinned run IDs so the report can be replayed.
description:
After ci-dedupe-06 lands, confirm the expected savings and catch any rise in queue churn early. The decision is reversible by design; this item owns the reversal.

Baseline to compare against (2026-08-23 to 2026-09-16): pull_request pr.yml 45,562 runner-minutes per 25 days; merge_group 21,585; heavy-tier merge_group failures 0 in 318 runs; typical PR feedback ~21 min.
